name: switch
title: Switch
purpose: Control an immediately applied boolean setting with native form and switch semantics.

composition.control: A native checkbox with role switch is associated with the visible label and optional hint.
composition.migration: This is the renamed former boolean Toggle. The toggle name now refers to a pressed-state button.

accessibility: Associate every switch with a stable id and visible label.
Keep supporting text connected through aria-describedby.
Preserve native required and disabled semantics.
commonMistakes: Using Switch for a delayed confirmation.
Importing the new Toggle as a compatibility alias.
